caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron gate with vertical bars, ornate spear-shaped finials on top, and decorative elements, including circular patterns in the center and two symmetrical lock plates on either side of the gate. The gate is colored in shades of brown and gold, giving it a metallic appearance. Behind the gate stands a large, elaborate cross featuring floral-like decorations at the ends and the intersection, also rendered in similar brown and gold tones. In the background, there are two white columns and parts of a classical-style stone building with geometric architectural details, all shaded in light blue and gray. The ground consists of light blue and gray paved stones. In the lower right corner, two separate detail drawings are present: one of a vertical post or baluster, and one of a decorative rosette, both matching the style and color of the main gate. The composition is centered on the gate and cross, with architectural elements providing context and scale.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
